job.purpose: Census: settled markets of US macro release series and four hourly temperature series before a fixed cut, plus one Economics series list, to count markets and release dates per series. No candle, no test.
job.heldout: FIXED date constant: closes at or after 2026-10-17T00:00:00Z are never requested (44 markets requests carry max_close_ts = 1792195199, one second before; KXFED and KXFEDDECISION carry 1758067199, 2025-09-16T23:59:59Z, before FEDIMPL1's frozen holdout of the last 10 meetings from 2025-09-17). The held-out windows are therefore not requested by this job; a later test of these families reads only from the cut on, under its own registration.
job.notes: Requests at most 137 pages plus 12 for repeats after a 429; at 5 s that is about 13 minutes. Hourly temperature: 30 days of closes (2026-09-17 to the cut). A series name that does not exist returns an empty list and costs one request.

stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal
